theme_strategy: Dual Aesthetic Architecture. Dark futuristic 'Cyberpunk' for Admin/Owner Dashboards. Warm, appetizing, premium 'Modern Restaurant' for the Public Customer Menu.

rules: No Inter or generic sans for headings.
Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
Overlines and labels must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Dashboard numbers and analytics use JetBrains Mono.

surfaces_and_borders.dashboard_cards: Grid Borders strategy. 1px solid border-white/10. No thick rounded corners, max rounded-md. Flat background, no muddy transparency.
surfaces_and_borders.marketing_hero: Dark void background. Heavy use of radial gradient meshes behind content. Tracing beam effect on feature cards.
surfaces_and_borders.public_menu_cards: Minimalist cardless or subtle glassmorphism. rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for food items. Image heavy.
surfaces_and_borders.glassmorphism_rules: For sticky headers/floating navs: backdrop-blur-xl with bg-black/60 (dark) or bg-white/70 (light). 1px delicate inner stroke mandatory. NEVER pure transparent.

layouts_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use 2-3x more spacing. p-8, p-12, p-16 for containers.
layouts_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (Mode B). Tight gaps (gap-4). Span logic utilized for charts.
layouts_and_spacing.public_menu_grid: Mobile-First. 1 column on mobile, 2-3 on desktop. Large image focus.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) on the dashboard base to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.gradients: No 100% full-screen gradients. Use localized blur circles (glows) behind key elements like the QR code generator.
visual_enhancers.badges: Pill-shaped, dense, high contrast. e.g., bg-red-500/10 text-red-500 border border-red-500/20.

animations_motion.hover_states: translate-y-[-2px] with subtle shadow boost and border color illumination.
animations_motion.entrance: Framer motion staggered fade-up for menu items and dashboard widgets.
animations_motion.microinteractions: Button active state scale(0.98). QR code generation scanning line animation.

marketing_hero.description: Futuristic neon restaurant vibe, use for Super Admin / Landing Page Hero.

public_menu_burger.description: Premium gourmet burger on dark background. Use in customer-facing menu.

public_menu_coffee.description: Artisan coffee pour. Use in customer-facing menu category.

qr_scan_action.description: Person scanning QR code. Use for marketing features section.

component_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp depending on theme. Must have distinct focus and hover states. Never rely on inheritance for hover text color.
component_instructions.cards: Do not overuse Shadcn default cards for marketing. Build custom HTML/Tailwind structures for overlapping and bento grid asymmetry. Use Shadcn for Admin panels but customize radii and borders.
component_instructions.tables: Shadcn tables with custom dense spacing for Admin Dashboard.
component_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Never native inputs. Use custom validation feedback.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast compliance. Text below 18px needs 4.5:1. Never use gray-on-gray.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute. Format: kebab-case, role-based. e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button'
accessibility.focus: Explicit focus:ring-2 on all inputs and buttons. Never outline-none without replacement.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
DO NOT use Inter, Space Grotesk, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato for headings. Use Outfit or Cabinet Grotesk.
DO NOT apply universal transitions like 'transition: all'. It breaks transforms.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
DO NOT use AI assistant emojis for icons.
Create depth through layered design elements and Z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop-blur-xl and inner strokes. NEVER pure transparent.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Implement micro-animations on all interactive elements.
Use the specific image URLs provided. Never use placeholder text for images.
Dual Aesthetic: Admin/Owner dashboards must be dark, dense, high-end cyberpunk. Public menu must be light, warm, appetizing, and mobile-first.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute.
